_readme: Har setting yahan se badalti hai. Milestone 1 mein Gemini/discovery/ASR band hain (wo M2 mein aayenge).

canvas._note: Final video ka size aur fps.

clip._note: Har moment ka preferred_clip_sec follow hota hai (normally 3-9s). Koi hard 6s cap nahi. Image/still 10-20s.

align._note: script_cue_exact ko SRT/script line se match karne ke thresholds (handoff Stage 2).

dialogue._note: DIALOGUE locator ke subtitle-match thresholds (handoff Stage 4). M1 mein sirf inhi se accept hota hai — koi Gemini nahi.

qa._note: Local quality checks. blackFrameRatio = kitni frames tak kaali/froze ho to reject.

render._note: allowSilent=false => production ko voiceover audio zaroori (missing audio = fail, misleading DONE nahi). Test harness true set karta hai.

tools._note: Windows par PATH mein na ho to poora path daalo. Khaali = PATH se dhoondo. jsRuntime khaali = auto (Deno 2.3+ prefer, warna Node 22+); ya 'deno' / 'deno:C:\\path\\deno.exe' / 'node'.

concurrency._note: Ek sath kitne moments process hon. Dheema laptop ho to 1 kar do.
